data.name: Initiate a Payment
data.description:
Initiates an Interac payin (deposit) by submitting encrypted transaction details to the Interac Gateway.
Authentication
AES-256 Encryption — Transaction data is encrypted using your merchant_api_key (environment variable). No API key header is sent; the encryption itself serves as authentication.
Parameters (x-www-form-urlencoded)
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| merchant_id | string | Yes | Your 8-character merchant identifier |
| details | str
data.evaluateGuide:
Starts an Interac deposit by submitting encrypted transaction details to the Paramount Commerce gateway. Use it to initiate a customer payin. 
Use for: Interac deposits, encrypted transaction submission, customer payins
Not supported: Payment status retrieval, refunds, payouts

data.name: Create Payment (SEPA Credit Transfer) - Initiate Payment
data.description:
Creates a payment initiation request (SEPA Credit Transfer).
Documentation: https://docs.mambu.com/api/payments-mpg/initiate-payment/
Quick Start:
- Ensure the Payments capability is enabled for your tenant and you have an API consumer with the MANAGE_PAYMENTS permission and a valid API key.
- Send a POST request to /api/v1/payments with a payment initiation JSON body (see Open API Specification for the full request schema).
- Include the API key in the apikey request header and optionally an Idempotency-Key header for safe retries.
Parameters Explained:
- Request headers:
  - apikey (required): Your Payments API key. Add as header apikey: {{apiKey}}.
  - Content-Type (required): application/json (or application/xml if the endpoint accepts XML for this request; check Open API Specification).
  - Accept (recommended): application/json.
  - Idempotency-Key (optional): Unique idempotency key (UUID v4 recommended) to avoid duplicate processing for retries.
- Path: /api/v1/payments — POST (no path variables).
- Body (required): Payment initiation object (JSON). The page does not include the full request schema; consult the collection Open API Specification or the SEPA Credit Transfer Technical Information for field mapping. Note: SEPA Credit Transfer payments can only be created for the current date.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 201 Created — Payment initiation request created successfully. Check Location response header to poll the created resource.
- 400 Bad Request — Validation error: verify request JSON structure and required fields (amount, accounts, identifications, dates, etc.). Use the OpenAPI schema to validate payload.
- 405 Method Not Allowed — Wrong HTTP method; ensure you use POST.
- 415 Unsupported Media Type — Wrong or missing Content-Type header; set Content-Type: application/json (or application/xml if supported by the endpoint in your tenant).
- 500 Internal Server Error / 503 Service Unavailable — Server-side errors; retry later and contact Mambu support if persistent.
Edge Cases:
- SEPA Credit Transfer scheme: payments using this scheme can only be created for the current date (cannot schedule future-dated SEPA Credit Transfers).
- The MPG will generate a pacs.008 ISO 20022 message from the provided payload; refer to the SEPA XML mapping article for how fields map into pacs.008.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Not documented on this page. Consult your tenant SLA / Open API Specification or contact Mambu if you need rate limit information.
Documentation Links:
- Open API Specification (collection): https://docs.mambu.com/api/payments-mpg/
- SEPA mapping and XML technical information: https://support.mambu.com/docs/sepa-credit-transfer-technical-information

data.name: Initiate Credit Transfer (ISO20022 payment DTO)
data.description:
Creates a SEPA Credit Transfer using an ISO20022-style payload.
Documentation: https://docs.mambu.com/api/payments-mpg/initiate-payment/
Quick Start:
- Use POST {{baseUrl}}/api/v1/payments/credit-transfers with apikey header and X-Request-ID.
Parameters Explained:
- X-Request-ID (header, required) — unique request id.
- Idempotency-Key (header, optional) — idempotency UUID.
- Body accepts ISO20022-like payment fields (ISO mapping schema Iso20022PaymentDTO).
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 400 when required ISO20022 fields are missing or not compliant.
Edge Cases:
- For bulk ISO20022 messages ensure each payment fits volume constraints documented in user guide.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Not specified on this page.
data.evaluateGuide:

Use for: ISO 20022 credit transfer, SEPA payment, structured bank transfer
Not supported: Payment retrieval, refunds, card payments
